svg.aria-label: 최근 활동 – 공개 저장소 커밋 · 기준 2026-11-02 15:02 KST. 1) jekyll-theme-modootoday: Spec: link five orphan ADRs to the files they govern; archive the finished P1/P2 change doc (1일 전). 2) jekyll-theme-modootoday: Ruby: 3.3 is the oldest supported Ruby (3.2 is end-of-life); CI adds Ruby 4.0 as an allowed-failure Jekyll 4 entry (1일 전). 3) jekyll-theme-modootoday: QA scripts: lighthouse.sh stops when the port is in use and no longer leaves its http.server or temp dir behind; build-docs.sh removes its temp config; RELEASING lists i18n/ among packaged files (1일 전). 4) specfold: fix: refuse a second successor and point superseded edits at the current one (C246) (1일 전). 5) kinekino: Add roadmap and milestones plan (1일 전). 6) meari: docs(site): add Markdown twins, llms.txt and llms-full.txt for every page (1일 전). 7) meari: docs(site): pin jekyll-theme-modootoday v1.4.1 (1일 전). 8) .github: docs: rewrite maintainer README (2일 전).
